full_name: Hope Harvey | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Hope Harvey is a PhD candidate in sociology and social policy at Harvard University. Her research addresses questions related to poverty, the family, housing and neighborhoods, and access to social programs.
